about_the_game:
【All characters in the game are over 18 years old】

There is a Discord group link on the right panel

Game Introduction:

The player will play as the protagonist 【Zhu】. Zhu loves to fantasize... dreaming of wealth, glory, and being surrounded by thousands of beautiful women...

But in reality, he's penniless and has to pay high rent every week. Under such pressure, what choices will the player-controlled character make?

In the game, you can encounter the landlord’s daughter 【Xiaoqian】, the twin sisters 【Xiaoyue and Xiaoyou】, and the landlady, depending on your choices.

Your actions will trigger different reactions and endings. 【The game has multiple endings】

Character Introductions:

【Xiaoyue】

One of the twin sisters that Zhu meets, known for her playful personality

【Xiaoyou】

One of the twin sisters that Zhu meets. She is shyer than her sister, but in some ways, has a hidden side unknown to others

【Xiaoqian】

The landlord’s daughter, Xiaoqian, has an impressive figure.

【Qianyuan】

The landlady and Xiaoqian’s mother. She’s usually calm while doing business, but becomes very fierce when the rent is overdue.

【Gameplay】

This is a time and stats-driven game. For example, 【Workout Points】 and 【Fantasy Points】. Different values at different times will trigger different results. At the end of the story, you will face the final ending, which judges you based on your previous actions.

Come play as the protagonist 【Zhu】 to save or destroy his life!
